intent: Invariant: order by t_device only; packets delayed up to the configured window are re-indexed chronologically. Internal sorted structure; accept inserts then releases samples older than now - window (window from TelemetryProperties.reorderWindowSeconds, no hardcoded 60). Framework-free, not thread-safe by contract (caller serializes).

methods.signature: public java.util.List<TelemetrySample> accept(TelemetrySample sample, long nowEpochMs)
